messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I woke up, I could not stand on my leg.

output.original_text: When I woke up, I could not stand on my leg.
output.joy: When I woke up, I was just so happy to be alive, even though I couldn't stand on my leg!
output.sadness: When I woke up, it was heartbreaking to realize I could not stand on my leg.
output.fear: When I woke up, a wave of panic hit me as I found I could not stand on my leg.
output.anger: When I woke up, I was furious to discover that I couldn’t stand on my leg!
output.surprise: When I woke up, I was shocked to find I could not stand on my leg.
output.disgust: When I woke up, it was utterly repulsive to feel that I could not stand on my leg.
